The task: Write UI strings for a player app in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). Scene: A user opens a recorded screen/video content and it cannot be played because the file format is not supported.

- s1: error message (one sentence)
- s2: a button on the error screen
- s3: the name of this feature area at the top of the screen

Need to use Taiwan Traditional Chinese UI wording, avoid mainland terms. Note: 視頻 → 影片, 文件 → 檔案, 格式 stays.

s1: Error message, one sentence. E.g., 「無法播放此影片，檔案格式不支援。」or 「此檔案格式不支援，無法播放。」

s2: A button — common options: 「確定」、「返回」、「關閉」、「瞭解詳情」、「選擇其他檔案」. Typical error screen button: 「確定」or 「返回」. Maybe 「關閉」. Let's pick something sensible like 「確定」 or 「返回上一頁」. A button on the error screen — simple: 「確定」or 「關閉」.

s3: Name of the feature area at top — the "功能區" at top of screen. Perhaps 「播放器」 or 「影片播放」 or 「播放」. Hmm. "畫面頂端這個功能區的名稱" — probably something like 「影片」 (the video section). Could be 「播放」 or 「我的影片」. Since it's a player app with recorded screen content, the top area might be called 「影片播放」 or just 「播放器」. I'd go with 「影片」 — but as a feature area name, maybe 「影片庫」 or 「播放紀錄」? The context: user taps a recorded screen content… The top feature area might be the player section. I think 「影片播放」 is safe, or simply 「播放器」.

Avoid mainland terms: 視頻→影片 used. 文件→檔案 used. 格式 is fine.

s1 must be one sentence: 「無法播放：此檔案格式不支援。」 That's one sentence with colon. Or 「檔案格式不支援，無法播放。」 Fine.

Ensure Taiwan style punctuation: use 「，。」 and full-width.

Output only JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3.

Let me decide:
- s1: 「無法播放此影片，檔案格式不支援。」
- s2: 「確定」 — or 「返回」. Buttons on error screens: 「好」/「確定」/「關閉」. I'll use 「確定」.
- s3: 「影片播放」

Alternatively s3 could be 「播放」. Hmm, "畫面頂端這個功能區" — a feature area/tab at top. Could be 「影片」 tab. I'll go with 「影片播放」? Or 「播放器」. I think 「影片」 might be too generic. Given the app is a player app, the top area containing this playback feature might be 「播放器」. I'll choose 「影片播放」— hmm.

Actually maybe the feature area is where recorded screen contents live: 「螢幕錄製」? The content is "錄好的畫面內容" (recorded screen content). The feature area at top could be 「錄影」 or 「螢幕錄製」. But safer generic: 「影片」.

I'll go with 「影片」 as the section name. Hmm, but "功能區的名稱" suggests something like a tab title. 「影片」 works as a tab name.
